item.title: Our Savior’s Lutheran School holds its Christmas program
item.description: Students of Our Savior’s Lutheran School in Crookston presented their Christmas program on Thursday, December 11. Students shared the story “From Everlasting to Everlasting: The Story of the Christmas Wreath”. Through Scripture, song, and recitations; the Advent wreath, crown of thorns, laurel wreath, and Christmas wreath histories and connections to Christianity were explained.
